description: A delete without confirm: an error that asks the user.

error.detail: deleting clips cannot be undone; the end user must agree, then the call carries confirm true

nextStep.message: Deleting clips cannot be undone or restored, and a content no other clip shows leaves the project with them. Tell the user which clips would go (dry_run: true lists them); only after the user explicitly agrees, call again with confirm: true.
